answer: Every licence carries a story the applicant did not write. Chartered cricket umpire registration with cricket board attestation is that story, filed as a registration the board renews after match audits. The terrace is the archive behind it — entries made by other hands, for other reasons, years before any reward was on offer. A forger must rewrite the whole archive, and the island is the first entry's price: a supervisor's time, a fee, a day of real work. The wharf is the issuer's own copy, waiting to be compared.
